# Cambodian Institute for Cooperation and Peace (CICP)

> A Cambodian think tank providing research, analysis, and policy briefings on Mekong region security, ASEAN integration, and Southeast Asian foreign policy.

CICP is a leading research institution focused on regional cooperation and peace-building in Southeast Asia. The organization publishes peer-reviewed journals, policy briefs, and research reports addressing critical issues in Cambodia, the Greater Mekong Subregion, and broader Indo-Pacific geopolitics.

## Key Topics

- ASEAN
- Mekong Region
- Cambodia
- Foreign Policy
- Regional Security
- Southeast Asia
- Greater Mekong Subregion
- Diplomatic Relations
- Regional Integration
- Thailand-Cambodia Relations
- Indo-Pacific
- Think Tank Research
- Journal of Greater Mekong Studies
- Policy Analysis
- Regional Dialogue

- [Front Page - Cambodian Institute for Cooperation and Peace](https://cicp.org.kh): Homepage for CICP think tank focusing on Cambodia, Mekong region foreign policy and research
- [Publications Archive](https://cicp.org.kh/publications): Main publications archive featuring Journal of Greater Mekong Studies and diplomatic briefings

## Academic Publications

- [Journal of Greater Mekong Studies Archives](https://cicp.org.kh/cat/journal-of-greater-mekong-studies): Archive of academic journal on Greater Mekong region studies and ASEAN security
- [Books Archives](https://cicp.org.kh/cat/books): Collection of research books on Cambodia policy, ASEAN studies, and regional analysis

## Policy Briefings & Reports

- [Diplomatic Briefing Archives](https://cicp.org.kh/cat/diplomatic-briefing): Archive of diplomatic briefings on Southeast Asia, ASEAN relations and foreign policy
- [Outcome Reports Archives](https://cicp.org.kh/cat/outcome-reports): Reports on Mekong cooperation, regional dialogue, and sustainable development initiatives
